name: shared-lib
description: Move logic out of Astro frontmatter into `shared/lib/*.ts` and cover it with a vitest test. Use when a component's or page's frontmatter grows past assembling classes, when demo data needs shaping or formatting, when the same helper appears in two components, or when the user asks for a helper, utility or unit test under `shared/`. Covers what belongs there, module conventions, the sibling `*.test.ts` rule, deterministic demo data, and the strict-TypeScript patterns the repo uses.
